description: Feedback on a lesson that was suggested to you (project lesson ids, or library:<id> for lessons from your other projects): helpful=true if it led to the fix, false if it was wrong or irrelevant. retire=true stops suggesting it (it stays on disk). Ratings and automatic outcomes drive ranking and export.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.
